What is a Nuzlocke?

CHALLENGE RUN

A Nuzlocke is a self-imposed hardcore ruleset for Pokémon games: less safety net, more attachment to your team — and every route matters. The rules are voluntary and not built into the games; you choose how strict the run is.

Play solo, pair up in a Soul Link, add a randomizer, run Hardcore (no boxing), or use dupes/shiny clauses — most players customize. This tracker supports solo and multiplayer runs including Soul Link.

Core rules
  • Catch only the first wild Pokémon on each route or area — no second chance if it faints or flees.
  • If a team Pokémon faints, it is dead (release or permanently boxed).
  • Nickname every Pokémon you catch — that bond is part of the challenge.
